content: PL/SQL static analysis options: ZPA (felipebz/zpa) is an actively maintained (releases within days as of research date) open-source ANTLR-based PL/SQL/Oracle SQL parser + SonarQube plugin with 50+ lint rules, ships a standalone zpa-toolkit jar (Java 11+) to dump the AST -- useful for programmatic spec extraction (signatures, cursor/exception usage) independent of ora2pg. Trivadis plsql-analyzer stores parse trees in DB tables for querying but requires a live Oracle instance (not available here). ora2pg itself can also be pointed at a file (-i) without an Oracle connection and includes a complexity/assessment report mode useful for triaging which of the 48 packages are riskiest to translate first.
